note: Every text of a translation file is LF only and every reader makes it so BEFORE anything else — keys, v, and the texts of the format 2 (written forms, link `to`/`was`/`own`, refused entries) — so that no hash is taken over a CR. CRLF first, then a lone CR. Nothing else is a line ending: NEL, U+2028 and U+2029 are text. The mod, the Manager, the site and the editors all answer from these cases.

to_lf.out: the text with LF alone; null stays null

in.line: a line in the file's form, format 2 fields included

of_line.out: the same line with LF alone in every text it holds (answers are partial: a case names what it pins)

cases.why: CRLF is one line ending, written LF
a CR alone (the old Mac form) is a line ending too
a file that mixes the three comes out with one
CR, then CRLF: two line endings, never three — the CRLF is taken first
LF then CR is two line endings (it is not a CRLF)
a text that is only a CR
no text stays no text: a null value is a value

in.text: ab c de f

cases.out: ab c de f
cases.why: NEL, the line and paragraph separators, vertical tab and form feed are characters of the game's text, not line endings: the hash freezes them too
text with no CR comes back as it is, whatever script it is in
a written form of the format 2 is read like a translation: a file from elsewhere is normalised, never refused
the `to`, the `was` and the `own` of a link too
a line that holds no CR is the same line
